appDesc.message: Send messages with 'Ctrl+Enter' on ChatGPT and other AI chats in Firefox.

grantNote.message: Your browser calls this "read and change your data". It is only used to detect Enter key presses, never to read anything on the page.

optionsIntro.message:
Sites shown with an Allow access button are opt-in.
Enable them here, or from the extension icon while you are on the site.
Pinning the icon to your toolbar makes that quicker.

sponsorNote.message: Free and open source, with no ads and no tracking.
